evidence.exact_span: 31 The appeal was thereupon dismissed for the reason that Mr Boensch, knowing the matter was listed for hearing, had not appeared to prosecute his appeal.

34 So far as I can tell no step was ever taken to advise Lindgren J of this unhappy sequence of events although, in the proceedings before me, it was suggested on Mr Pascoe's behalf that Lindgren J may have dismissed Mr Boensch's appeal without power to do so.
